hook: *90 seats, 1 crore votes*: Revanth's target for the next polls
hook_b: *90 seats, 1 crore votes*: Revanth's target for the next polls
tldr: At the Telangana Congress extended executive meeting, CM Revanth Reddy said the party would win 90 of 119 seats with one crore votes next time.

beats.what: He said the party would take welfare and development schemes to people after Sankranti and is watching what leaders say in public and in private.
beats.why: Congress currently holds 64 seats; he also told leaders to work in villages rather than lobby in Delhi.
beats.care: Expect stepped-up party outreach in your area after Sankranti.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: He said Congress also aims to make Rahul Gandhi Prime Minister and win Telangana's Lok Sabha seats.

cards.q: Do early seat targets change how you see a party?

qs: Which districts would Congress need to win to reach 90?
How does the party plan to measure each leader's contribution?

facts.t: Revanth says Congress enrolled *48 lakh* digital members in 90 days before the last polls.

viz.verdict: A party target, not a result
About 7.6 lakh more votes than last time

watch: Party outreach on welfare schemes is to start after Sankranti.

sources.name: The Hindu
sources.title: Congress will return to power in Telangana for second term with 90 seats and one crore votes: Revanth Reddy

fact: Revanth Reddy targets *90 seats* and one crore votes in next Telangana polls
twist: Congress won 64 seats last time with 92,35,833 votes, about 7.6 lakh short of one crore.
